title: Jesus... My Last Single Friend Got Engaged Today

bible.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my last single friend got engaged today. I smiled in every photo. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then I came home, and my aunt asked again when it's going to be my turn.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You were happy for her and hurting for you at the same time. Both of those can be true.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone keeps saying the right person will come. What if he never does?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I won't hand you a date. But I can tell you this: your life isn't on hold until someone arrives.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It feels like everyone is moving forward, and I'm stuck in the same chapter.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not stuck. I saw every one of your days before the first one came. None of them are wasted.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your story isn't late. It's yours.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What's one good thing about this season of your life? 🙏
